summary: Caster becomes Insubstantial and may move within 50' of their start; cannot end it within 10' of a living enemy; fails if Stopped.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: While Insubstantial in this way, may move as they wish within 50' of their starting point; ends with the Insubstantial State (N1).

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Drawback: only while within 10' of a living enemy, the caster may not end the Insubstantial State.

requirements.note: Blink fails if the caster is Stopped.

restrictions.note: Caster may not end the Insubstantial State within 10' of a living enemy.

termination.note: Caster may end the Insubstantial State at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation, but not within 10' of a living enemy (L1).
If the Insubstantial State is ended, the movement allowance also ends.

references.name: stopped
references.note: Blink fails if the caster is Stopped.

clarifications.text: Caster may not end the Insubstantial State while within 10' of a living enemy.
Ending the Insubstantial State ends the rest of the effect too.
